text: The operation was approved in mid-2024, and measurable outcomes are at an early stage. Quantifiable inputs include US$125 million total financing, with expected outcomes such as increased government revenue, streamlined business operations, and improved disaster preparedness. The Cat-DDO provides immediate fiscal liquidity post-disaster.

metadata.solution_name: Fiji Growth and Resilience First Development Policy Financing with a Catastrophe Deferred Drawdown Option (Cat-DDO)
